text: Step-by-step managed processes let your agent handle founder tasks like incorporating, hiring, and payroll
quote: Step-by-step managed processes to let your agent handle incorporating, hiring, payroll, and more.

text: Start a process in one agent and finish it in another, on laptop or phone
quote: Start a process in one agent and finish it in another, on your laptop or your phone.

text: Switch to a new AI model without losing company data or work in progress
quote: Move to a new model the day it ships. Your company and work in progress come with you.

text: Runs no model itself; work uses the AI plan you already pay for
quote: Ultrametric runs no model. The work uses the AI plan you already pay for.

text: Hosted remote MCP server that agents can connect to via a server URL
quote: In your agent host's remote MCP settings, add a connection with this server URL: https://api.ultrametric.ai/mcp

text: Official CLI installable globally with a single npm command at a pinned version
quote: npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1

text: JSON mode lets an agent complete setup flows without an interactive prompt
quote: With `--json`, the agent gets the link and controls completion without an interactive prompt.

text: init command previews changes with a dry run, then writes only the selected skill files
quote: ultrametric init --dry-run --json ... The first command previews changes. The second writes the selected skill files.

text: Commit generated skill files to the repo to share the setup with your team
quote: You can commit the skill files to share the setup with your team.

text: Page through a catalog of process guides and retrieve the instructions your agent needs
quote: Page through the catalog and retrieve the instructions your agent needs.

text: Select a specific guide version by its integer version number
quote: To select a specific version, replace `VERSION` with its positive integer version number

text: Some adapters add local project context and a template to guide responses, and that context stays local
quote: The `company-profile` and `ai-native-assessment` adapters accept `--path` to add local project context and a template to the guide response. That context stays local during retrieval.

text: Persists decisions, documents, and process progress for the next session
quote: Keep decisions, documents, and process progress for the next session.

text: Create separate runs of a recurring process for a particular period
quote: Use `--period` when a recurring process needs a separate run for a particular period.

text: Find a saved company, run, or record from a new agent session
quote: Find a saved company, run, or record in a new agent session.

text: Retrieve the revision history of a record or run
quote: For history, select one record or run: ultrametric context get --record RECORD_ID --history --json

text: Record updates require the current revision, so one session can't overwrite another session's changes
quote: An update to an existing record must include its current revision so one session does not overwrite another session's changes.

text: Idempotent saves: retry a timed-out save safely with the same update key
quote: If a save times out, retry the exact input with the same update key.

text: CLI and MCP share the same process service and hosted company records across one account
quote: Both connections use the same process service and hosted company records. Sign in to the same account and organization to continue work across them.

text: HTTP API for reading process guides and working with company context
quote: Read process guides and work with company context over HTTP.

text: Downloadable OpenAPI contract with request and response schemas
quote: download the [OpenAPI contract](/contracts/openapi.json) for request and response schemas

text: CLI JSON mode returns versioned structured results on stdout and structured errors on stderr
quote: Successful results appear on stdout as a `schemaVersion` and `data` object. Errors appear on stderr as a `schemaVersion` and `error` object

text: Staging environment for use with test accounts and test data instead of production
quote: The `--environment` option accepts `production` or `staging`. Use staging only when working with a staging account and test data.

text: doctor command reports the CLI version, the API origin, and local file locations
quote: `doctor` reports the CLI version, selected API origin, and local file locations.

text: Granular permission scopes, such as a separate scope for reading protected context
quote: Read protected context | Also `context:protected:read`

text: Status tool reports account, email verification, organization, and environment, plus a process's release access and availability
quote: Read the signed-in account, email verification, selected organization, and environment. Supply processId to check its release access and availability.

text: Cursor-based pagination for API and catalog results
quote: If `nextCursor` is not null, use that value for the next request.

text: CLI adds Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code
quote: The CLI can add Ultrametric instructions to a project for Codex and Claude Code.

text: Agent compares options using your requirements and Ultrametric's cited research
quote: I'll use your requirements and Ultrametric's cited research to compare the options.
